name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just: the same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them. Not every man is allowed into the council of the Pharisees, so this scripture lets you know Joseph of Arimathaea had close relations with the Pharisees, but he was a follower of Christ.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

points: “And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews”. Joseph of Arimathea was a rich man, a disciple, a student of Christ, but secretly. He stayed low, and flexed occasionally. If the Jews, meaning the Pharisees and the scribes, had found out he was a follower of Christ, they would have tried to destroy his money, as we saw with Nick Cannon and DeSean Jackson.

“Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews.” Joseph of Arimathea, another of the bourgeoisie, was a secret disciple of Christ. He didn’t want to lose his wealth or his position, so he followed Christ secretly.

note.label: THE BLACK BOULÉ & BOURGEOISIE IN THE BIBLE
